testsuite.name: dev.uas.netty.memory.MmapOffHeapTest

testcase.name: a windowed mapping of a region is correct and bounded
CRC32C over the mapping matches the same digest computed by streaming
a mapped window returns the file's bytes and is a direct, off-heap buffer
closing drops the mapping and reports whether the JVM unmapped it
reading the whole 64 MiB mapping costs almost no heap

testsuite.system-out: explicit unmap succeeded: true mmap read of 64 MiB grew the heap by 0.00 MiB
